findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_postal_pack" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_services, get_postal_pack_info, list_counties, get_guides, get_business_info · Private data: get_business_info, request_postal_pack · Public sink: list_services, get_postal_pack_info, how_to_sell, list_counties, request_postal_pack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_services, get_postal_pack_info, list_counties, get_guides, get_business_info · Private data: get_business_info, request_postal_pack · Public sink: list_services, get_postal_pack_info, how_to_sell, list_counties, request_postal_pack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
